from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_list_users


def test_get_user_ok():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"})


def test_get_user_invalid():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400


def test_get_user_missing():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "99"})[0] == 404


def test_list_users_ok():
    status, data = handle_list_users({})
    assert status == 200
    assert data["users"] == [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"}]
    assert data["page"] == 1
    assert data["page_size"] == 10
    assert data["total"] == 2


def test_list_users_pagination():
    status, data = handle_list_users({"page": "2", "page_size": "1"})
    assert status == 200
    assert data["users"] == [{"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"}]
    assert data["page"] == 2
    assert data["page_size"] == 1
    assert data["total"] == 2

    assert handle_list_users({"page_size": "0"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_list_users({"page_size": "101"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_list_users({"page": "abc"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_list_users({"page_size": "abc"})[0] == 400
